item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President describes proposed legislation and offers a hortatory appeal to private labor and management; any legal consequences would arise only if Congress enacts the proposals, not from this segment itself.","evidence":"I urge the private sector--labor and management alike--to follow this example and minimize wage and price increases."},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"This is a request that Congress consider and enact proposed legislation, not presidential governance of agencies or a provision independently changing legal rights.","evidence":"I hope the Congress will consider these proposals and act on them promptly and favorably."}]}
